title.zh: 将南达沃省Malita市镇Malita医疗社区医院床位由15张增至25张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Malita Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Del Sur, From Fifteen (15) to Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Malita Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Del Sur, From Fifteen (15) to Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Malita Medicare Community Hospital tại Thị trấn Malita, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur từ mười lăm lên hai mươi lăm giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของ Malita Medicare Community Hospital ในเทศบาล Malita, จังหวัด Davao Del Sur จากสิบห้าเป็นยี่สิบห้าเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Malita Medicare Community Hospital di Kotamadya Malita, Provinsi Davao Del Sur dari lima belas menjadi dua puluh lima tempat tidur
title.ms: Akta menambah kapasiti katil daripada Malita Medicare Community Hospital di Perbandaran Malita, Wilayah Davao Del Sur daripada lima belas kepada dua puluh lima katil

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7242_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Malita Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao del Sur, is hereby increased from fifteen (15) to twenty-five (25) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
